0022600024.text: The Suns (1-2) host the Nuggets (1-1) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, with Phoenix 2nd in the Pacific at 2 games back and 11th in the West, while Denver sits 4th in the Northwest at 2 games back and 7th in the West, and the Suns are on a one-game losing streak after going 1-0 at home and 0-2 on the road. Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (out, oblique strain) are unavailable for Phoenix, and Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain) is unavailable for Denver. Phoenix lost all three meetings with Denver in 2025-26, and the most recent one was a 125-123 Suns loss in Phoenix on March 24, 2026, while the two teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27.
